brief: Ten cartoons at the bar. Money in kitchen words - a bar bill, a premium, a fare, a renewal, a rate, a tip - a different subject every time. Bring Abby into four. Every caption lands on its own.

panels.speaker: barclay
panels.caption: The second page is just four new names for my tip.
panels.action: Barclay holds the check presenter open; a second slip shows four short lines: Service, Admin, Wellness, Kitchen. Abby polishes a glass mid-wipe.
panels.tvPicture: The television picture shows three receipt printers spooling long curls of paper into a bin.

Abby's face reads WARM — amused or at ease, NEVER sad or downcast; when she serves, delivers or lands the line she is genuinely SMILING.
